---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new venom class, scoring rule, or pipeline improvement
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What would you like to add or change?

A clear description of the feature or improvement you're proposing.

## Motivation

What problem does this solve? What use case does it enable?

## Proposed approach (optional)

If you have a specific idea for implementation, describe it here.

## Supporting evidence

For new venom classes or scoring rules, please provide:

- At least 2–3 UniProt accessions that **should** match the new rule
- At least 1 accession that **should not** match (to assess specificity)
- A reference (paper, database entry, or InterPro family) supporting the classification criteria

| Accession | Should match? | Relevant domains/keywords |
|-----------|--------------|--------------------------|
| e.g. P00740 | Yes | Metalloproteinase, disintegrin |
| e.g. P12345 | No | — |

## Additional context

Any other information, links, or references.
